changelog:
Initial release of rock-solid-watchdog — a self-healing supervisor for local LLM inference servers.

- Monitors llama.cpp server health, auto-restarts on failure, and escalates if needed
- Configurable intervals, retry limits, and environment variables
- Supports logging, macOS/Linux notifications, and a custom hook system
- Runs as a plugin alongside OpenClaw gateway
- Easy bash setup and operation
summary: Monitors local llama.cpp servers on macOS, auto-restarts on failure, sends notifications, and supports customizable hooks for self-healing supervision.
